name: SaaS Launch
tagline: The launch film founders post on X: real screens, crisp type, a confident beat.

motion.direction: Product launch film. The real product carries it: browser windows of the actual site that scroll on their own, feature titles set large in tight sentence-case Inter with one benefit line each, lime on the single word that matters. Clean dark stage, soft pushes, every 2 s something new. Never invent claims; the site's own words only.
